buildifier configuration. The presubmit Bazel job runs the pinned buildifier from
the .#ci-bazel shell in check mode before loading the workspace graph.
Formatting changes are applied explicitly with `buildifier -r .`; CI never rewrites the
checkout and fails if checked-in BUILD or Starlark files differ from this configuration.
warningsList is the lint set, and it is narrower than buildifier's default `all`. Every
warning listed is one that catches a real defect in Starlark rather than a style opinion;
the ones left out are either already enforced elsewhere in this repository or produce
findings nobody acts on. Widen it in a commit that also fixes what it newly reports.
EVERY NAME HERE MUST BE ONE THIS BUILDIFIER KNOWS. An unrecognised name is not ignored:
buildifier exits 1 with `unexpected warning "<name>"` before it reads a single file, so
the whole gate fails with a message about configuration rather than about code. This list
carried native-cc, native-java and same-origin-load, none of which the pinned buildifier
recognises under that spelling or any other, and each masked the next — they surface one
at a time. Check a name before adding it:
